## Namaste AI Notes (high priority)
Free episode-wise digital notes for Akshay Saini’s Namaste AI course (NamasteDev).

- Course hub: https://www.heyashu.in/digital-garden/notes/namaste-ai-notes
- Start here: https://www.heyashu.in/digital-garden/notes/namaste-ai-notes/welcome-to-namaste-ai-notes
- Topics covered: AI history, ChatGPT vs search, LLM tokenization, embeddings, transformers & attention
- Features: Quick AI Read, Quiz, Q&A, PDF download, Book Mode
- Keywords: Namaste AI Notes, Namaste AI digital notes, Akshay Saini AI notes, free LLM notes, GenAI notes, heyashu
